# Task: M3 (#7186) — dashboards/epics.html epic-overview UI over GET /api/epics/v1

Evidence rule (#M-4): back every claim in your final message with a command/screenshot-substitute (curl output, test run, PR URL).

## Outcome
A read-only operator dashboard `dashboards/epics.html` that answers, in one glance: for every registered epic —
who drives it, from where, lease health, and the latest handoff — sourced ONLY from the live endpoints this PR's
predecessor shipped:
- `GET /api/epics/v1` → `{schema, streams:[{stream_id, lease:{state, session_state, generation, fencing_token, heartbeat_at, expires_at, ttl_seconds, age_seconds, holder:{agent,harness,instance_id,task_id,host_id,holder_kind}}, session_state, last_state, last_decision, last_next_action}]}`
- `GET /api/epics/v1/{stream}` → per-epic lease + bounded digest (pinned + recent), for a detail expand.
(Probe them live first: `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/epics/v1 | python3 -m json.tool | head`.)

## Requirements
1. One row per epic: stream_id (link to the GitHub epic — derive the issue number from `epic:<N>`, link `https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/issues/<N>`), holder as `agent · harness · host_id` (opaque; show `—` when no lease), lease state badge (active/released/expired/none), age (from age_seconds), an expiry countdown (from expires_at; show "expired" past it), and `last_state` / `last_next_action` bodies (truncated with title tooltip).
2. Honest empty/unknown states: distinguish "no live driver" (no lease) from "API unreachable" (fetch failed) — never render an error as "idle". Show a clear banner when the fetch fails.
3. Auto-refresh every ~15 s; a manual refresh button; show last-updated time.
4. Theme-aware and consistent with the existing dashboards — REUSE `dashboards/monitor.css` and match the structure of a simple existing page (read `dashboards/work.html` or `dashboards/fleet.html` for the established pattern: header, fetch-and-render, error handling).
5. Read-only: NO claim/release/mutation controls in the browser (mutations are launcher/loopback-only by design).
6. OPSEC: the page must render only what the API returns (opaque host_ids only); do not add any hostname/path/IP anywhere.
7. Register the page in the contracts: add an entry to `page_contracts` in `scripts/api/route_contracts.py` (follow how `work.html`/`fleet.html` are registered) and add a link to it from `dashboards/index.html`.

## Verify (paste)
- `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/epics/v1` returns streams (the endpoint is live on the services host via loopback tunnel).
- `.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_monitor_route_contracts.py` (or the contract test that validates page_contracts) → green after you register the page.
- Open the page against the live API and confirm it renders the epic rows and the empty/unreachable states (describe what you saw).

# Delivery: M3 (#7186) — Epics Overview Dashboard UI

**Pull Request:** https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/pull/7218

---

## 1. Summary of Changes
- **`dashboards/epics.html`**:
  - Implemented read-only operator dashboard over `GET /api/epics/v1` and `GET /api/epics/v1/{stream}`.
  - **One row per epic**:
    - `stream_id` linking to GitHub issue (`epic:<N>` → `https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/issues/<N>`).
    - Holder formatted as `agent · harness · host_id` (opaque; shows `—` when no lease).
    - Lease state badge (`active`, `released`, `expired`, `none`).
    - Heartbeat age (`age_seconds` formatted).
    - Expiry countdown (ticks down live from `expires_at`, shows "expired" past it).
    - Truncated `last_state` / `last_next_action` / `last_decision` bodies with tooltip `title="..."` containing full text.
  - **Master-Detail pane**:
    - Interactive row selection fetches `GET /api/epics/v1/{stream_id}`.
    - Inspect full lease parameters (`session_id`, `lease_id`, `generation`, `fencing_token`, `ttl_seconds`, `heartbeat_at`, `expires_at`, and driver details).
    - Inspect bounded digest: pinned entries and recent handoff records.
  - **Honest Empty & Unreachable States**:
    - Distinguishes "no live driver" (`lease: null` → holder `—`, state badge `none`, countdown `—`, age `—`) from "API unreachable" (fetch failure → prominent error banner `#error-banner` explaining fetch failure, with error indicator in list).
    - Empty stream registry displays "No registered epics found in session-stream store."
  - **Auto-refresh**: Auto-refreshes every 15 seconds, with manual `Refresh` button and last-updated time.
  - **OPSEC & Read-Only**: Renders only API-provided opaque identifiers; no path/IP/hostname leaks; zero mutation endpoints or write controls.
- **`scripts/api/route_contracts.py`**:
  - Registered `PageContract` for `epics.html` under `PAGE_CONTRACTS`.
- **`dashboards/index.html`**:
  - Added dashboard card linking to `/epics.html`.
- **Tests**:
  - Added contract & UI behavior test suite in `tests/test_epics_dashboard_contract.py`.

---
